Nichols Canyon Ride (Velo Club La Grange)

Los Angeles, CA · Westwood · Road

Nichols Canyon Ride (Velo Club La Grange) is a road group ride in Los Angeles, CA. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Raymond Fouquet Square. About 27 miles, difficult.

About the Nichols Canyon Ride (Velo Club La Grange) group ride

The Saturday club ride of one of LA's oldest and largest cycling clubs. Hard pace with racers in the group, so the club suggests newer riders try one of its easier weekday rides first. Open to non-members. Helmets, lights when dark, no aero bars, no earphones.
